title: REQ · BootScene shows store focus with the hover highlight and label
summary: BootScene applies focusedObjectId to its SceneObjects and the keyboard handler writes it
description: Context: BootScene subscribes to useGameStore and calls onStateChange; Tab and arrows call moveFocus and emit focusChange. Desired behavior: onStateChange focuses the SceneObject whose spec.id equals focusedObjectId and blurs the rest, and the keyboard handler stores the focused id. Expected result: a store focus change shows the same highlight and label as hover. Why: one source of truth for focus.
acceptance_criteria: Given objects bookshelf and bed, when focusedObjectId becomes 'bed', then bed.focus() is called and bookshelf.blur() is called if it was focused
Given focusedObjectId is null, when the store changes, then a focused object is blurred
Given Tab is pressed, when focus moves, then focusedObjectId in the store equals the focused object id and focusChange is still emitted
technical_constraints: Reuse SceneObject.focus and blur; do not render highlight in BootScene
